fixture: n independent local developmental units, each with three distinguishable local states: teachable-unlearned, stubborn-unlearned, learned; legal events query_i and teach1_i
interpretation: Every Cartesian combination of local developmental status is future-trace distinguishable, so exact global developmental minimization cannot quotient below 3^n states.
The same machine has a compact factorized description: n local state cells plus one shared six-entry local rule table; one teaching event updates one cell.
Thus minimal global predictive/developmental state complexity can be exponential while implementation/factorization remains compact and locally updatable.
This does not establish fundamental cognitive atoms: ordinary factored state models, DBNs, programs and factored MDPs already exploit such compact structure.
claim_ceiling: exact resource-factorization calibration only; no unique cognitive unit or GMI law
